272866421_21e73119.text: Orexin or hypocretin neurons originating from lateral and posterior hypothalamic areas send excitatory fibers to many areas of the brain

272866421_a3696ca0.text: .The orexin-A/hypocretin-1 and orexin-B/hypocretin-2 are two neuropeptides synthesized by neurons in the lateral hypothalamus and perifornical area (Belle et al., 2014)

272866421_02f59a14.text: .A variety of inputs received by Orexin neurons project to parts of the CNS which makes them perform "multi-tasking" and regulate many vital body functions like sleep/wake states, energy homeostasis, cognition mood, and others. Dysfunction of the orexinergic system also leads to different pathological conditions.
